questions.question: Choose the most appropriate SYNONYM for the word 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: 'CANDID' ek Adjective hai jiska arth 'khara, spasht aur nishkapat' (frank, forthright) hota hai. Option B ('Frank') iska direct synonym hai. Options A, C, aur D iske antonyms ya negative contrasts hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Same Part-of-Speech Concord

questions.question: What is the correct ANTONYM of the word 'HOSTILE'?
questions.explanation: 'HOSTILE' ka arth shatruta-purna ya virodhi hota hai. Options A, B, aur D teeno iske synonyms hain. Option C ('Amicable') ka arth mitrata-purna (friendly) hota hai, jo iska exact polar antonym hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Gradable Scale Extremes

questions.question: In legislative terminology, what is the closest SYNONYM of 'ABROGATE'?
questions.explanation: 'ABROGATE' ek formal legal verb hai jiska arth kisi kanoon, niyam ya treaty ko radd/nirast karna (repeal, revoke, annul) hota hai. Option B ('Repeal') iska direct legal equivalent hai. Option A ('Enact') aur Option C ('Promulgate') kanoon laagu karne ke antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-11: Collocational Compatibility & Register Law

questions.question: Which word is the standard grammatical ANTONYM of 'PLAUSIBLE'?
questions.explanation: Latin root ke aage bilabial 'P' hone par prefix 'in-' badal kar 'im-' ban jata hai (im- + plausible = Implausible). *Unplausible ya *displausible fabricated aur non-standard hain. Option C perfectly correct hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Phonetic Prefix Assimilation Rules

questions.question: Select the option that conveys a positive commendation of sensible spending, unlike 'miserly':
questions.explanation: 'Frugal' (Option C) ek positive (commendatory) word hai jo vivekpurna aur samajhdari bhare kharche ko represent karta hai. Options A ('Stingy'), B ('Parsimonious'), aur D ('Close-fisted') teeno pejorative (negative) hain jo kanjoosi aur selfishness ko darshate hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Tone & Connotation Polarity Concord

questions.question: What is the most fitting ANTONYM of 'CAPRICIOUS' in administrative law?
questions.explanation: 'CAPRICIOUS' ka arth man-mauji, asthir, aur unpredictable hota hai (synonyms: mercurial, fickle, arbitrary). Iska opposite sthir, dridh aur predictable hoga, jo Option B ('Steadfast') ya 'Constant' se vyakt hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Gradable Scale Extremes

questions.question: In the sentence: "His nervous laughter BELIED his calm demeanor.", choose the closest SYNONYM of 'BELIED':
questions.explanation: 'BELIE' (Verb) ka arth galat prabhav dena, vipreet saabit karna ya jhootha dikhana (contradict, disguise, disprove) hota hai. Nervous laughter ne uske calm hone ke daawe ko jhootha saabit kiya (contradicted). Options B aur D iske antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Contextual Sense Freezing in Polysemy

questions.question: Which of the following constitutes a RELATIONAL (converse) antonym pair?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-05 ke mutabiq, 'Predecessor — Successor' ek hi administrative position/relationship ko do alag perspectives se represent karte hain (converse relation). Option B aur D complementary pairs hain; Option C gradable pair hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Relational & Social Reciprocity Antonymy

questions.question: What is the exact SYNONYM of the word 'INFLAMMABLE'?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-09 ke tahat, 'INFLAMMABLE' aur 'FLAMMABLE' exact synonyms hain—dono ka matlab jo aag aasani se pakad le hota hai. Prefix 'in-' yahan intensive hai, negative nahi. Options A aur C iske antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate ANTONYM for 'EPHEMERAL':
questions.explanation: 'EPHEMERAL' (Adjective) ka arth kshanik ya thodi der rehne wala hota hai (synonyms: transient, fleeting, short-lived). Iska polar antonym 'Perpetual', 'Permanent' ya 'Eternal' (Option C: nirantar chalne wala) hota hai.

questions.question: Identify the word that is an ANTONYM of 'OBSEQUIOUS':
questions.explanation: 'OBSEQUIOUS' ka arth chaploos, ji-huzoori karne wala ya atyadhik dabbu (servile, fawning, sycophantic) hota hai. Iska opposite aatmavishvasi, nirdharit aur swadheen vyaktitva hota hai, jise 'Assertive' (Option B) ya 'Domineering' kehte hain.

questions.question: What is the true ANTONYM of 'BARREN'?

questions.question: Choose the most accurate SYNONYM of 'UBIQUITOUS':
questions.explanation: 'UBIQUITOUS' (Adjective) ka arth har jagah paaya jaane wala ya sarvavyapi hota hai. Option A ('Omnipresent') iska exact synonym hai. Option B ('Rare') iska antonym hai.

questions.question: What is the exact ANTONYM of 'QUIXOTIC'?

questions.question: In the phrase: "The commission submitted a LUCID report.", what is the meaning of 'LUCID'?

questions.question: Select the correct SYNONYM for the noun 'ADVERSITY':
questions.explanation: Rule RC-01 ke tahat target word 'ADVERSITY' ek abstract NOUN hai. Option B ('Misfortune') bhi Noun hai jo kathinai ya sankat ko darshata hai. Option A ('Adverse') Adjective hai aur Option D ('Adversely') Adverb hai, isliye POS mismatch ke kaaran reject hote hain.

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate SYNONYM for 'VACILLATE':
questions.explanation: 'VACILLATE' (Verb) ka arth do vicharon ya faislon ke beech dulamul hona ya hichkichana (waver, oscillate, dither) hota hai. Option B ('Waver') iska accurate synonym hai. Options A aur D iske antonyms hain; Option C ('Vacate' = khali karna) ek lookalike verb hai.

questions.question: What is the true ANTONYM of 'PERNICIOUS'?

questions.question: What is the correct grammatical ANTONYM of the noun 'ZEAL'?

questions.question: Choose the closest SYNONYM for 'ENIGMATIC':
questions.explanation: 'ENIGMATIC' ka arth rahasyamayee ya samajh na aane wala (mysterious, cryptic) hota hai. Option B ('Inscrutable' = unfathomable) iska exact synonym hai. Options A, C, aur D iske antonyms hain.

questions.explanation: 'FASTIDIOUS' ka arth har chhoti detail par dhyan dene wala aur baareekbeen (meticulous, scrupulous, punctilious) hota hai. Option B ('Meticulous') iska accurate synonym hai. Options A, C, aur D iske antonyms hain.
